questions.stem: A 42-year-old man came to the opd with c/o fever, flank pain & urgency to urinate. After investigations, he has been diagnosed with acute bacterial pyelonephritis. Which of the following drug can be given ?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ceftriaxone

Ceftriaxone is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections in your body. It is effective in infections of the brain, lungs, ear, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, blood and heart. It is also used to prevent infections during surgery.

questions.stem: A 52-year-old female came to the opd with c/o burning micturition & excessive pain while passing urine. The doctor advises her to do a urine culture & sensitivity. Before the reports, the doctor wants to start her with an empirical therapy using fluoroquinolones (fqs). The following fqs can be given except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Moxifloxacin

Moxifloxacin is the most potent fq against m. Tuberculosis & is extensively used in mdr-tb. It is primarily used for pneumonia, bronchitis, sinusitis, and otitis media, in which efficacy is comparable to β-lactam antibiotics. Because of bile excretion, urinary concentrations are low & hence it is not used for utis.

questions.stem: A 42-year-old male came to the opd with c/o burning micturition & excessive pain while passing urine. The doctor prescribes him with the drug nitrofurantoin. The mechanism of action of this drug is by:
questions.solutionHtml:
DNA damage
  • Nitrofurantoin causes damage to the DNA of cultured diploid human fibroblasts. As a consequence DNA synthesis is blocked. The damage is removed by the normal enzymatic DNA repair system.
  • Xeroderma pigmentosum fibroblasts which are defective in the excision endonuclease fail to repair nitrofurantoin-caused lesions.

questions.stem: A 48-year-old male, with a known case of gout under medication probenecid, came to the opd with c/o fever, painful & burning micturition. Nitrofurantoin should not be given in this case because :

options.label: A
options.text: Nitrofurantoin inhibits tubular secretion of probenecid

options.label: B
options.text: Probenecid inhibits tubular secretion of nitrofurantoin

options.label: D
options.text: Probenecid inhibits the metabolism of nitrofurantoin

questions.answerText: Probenecid inhibits tubular secretion of nitrofurantoin
questions.solutionHtml:
Probenecid inhibits tubular secretion of nitrofurantoin

questions.stem: A 28-year-old pregnant female came to the opd with c/o fever and painful & burning micturition. Nitrofurantoin has been given to this pregnant lady. The following adverse effects can be seen except :
questions.solutionHtml:
Chemical cystitis

Chemical cystitis & hematuria are seen with high doses of urinary antiseptic, methenamine given for long periods (not with nitrofurantoin).

questions.stem: A 26-year-old pregnant lady came to the opd with c/o lower abdominal pain, burning micturition & dysuria. After investigations, she has been diagnosed with uti. The following drugs can be given except :
questions.solutionHtml:
Norfloxacin

Levofloxacin is an antibiotic, used in the treatment of bacterial infections in adults and children (;6 months age). It is also used in treating infections of the urinary tract, nose, throat, skin and lungs (pneumonia). It cures the infection by stopping the further growth of the causative microorganisms.
